content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 - Quick Overview
BEL Probationary Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) has released the BEL Probationary Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification for 1 permanent vacancy in the E-II Grade at its Bengaluru Complex. Candidates holding a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB/BL) can apply through the offline application process on or before 20 August 2026. The selected candidate will receive a pay scale of Rs. 40,000 – Rs. 1,40,000 along with DA, HRA, medical benefits, provident fund, pension, and other allowances as per BEL rules. Candidates are advised to read the detailed notification carefully before submitting their application. Click Here to Download BEL Probationary Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF BEL Probationary Legal Officer Application Form

content_sections.heading: BEL Legal Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BEL has announced one vacancy for Probationary Legal Officer in E-II grade. The vacancy is unreserved.

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Legal Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BEL Probationary Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the educational qualification and age requirements prescribed by Bharat Electronics Limited. Candidates must possess a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB/BL) from a recognized Indian university. General category candidates must have secured First Class in LLB/BL. PwBD candidates are required to have secured at least Pass Class in LLB/BL. Candidates whose university follows a CGPA, credits or grade-point system should provide the relevant university-approved formula for converting their CGPA or credits into percentage marks.

content_sections.heading: BEL Legal Officer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the Probationary Legal Officer post is 25 years as on 1 July 2026 for candidates applying under the UR category. The age will be calculated as on 1 July 2026. If the candidate's date of birth is not available on the Matriculation or Higher Secondary certificate, a birth certificate issued by the competent authority will be considered.

rows.age_limit_relaxation: 10 Years relaxation for candidates with minimum 40% disability
Age relaxation as per Government guidelines

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Legal Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed in the pay scale of Rs. 40,000 - 3% - Rs. 1,40,000. The initial basic pay will be Rs. 40,000. In addition to basic pay, the selected candidate will be eligible for various allowances and benefits as per BEL rules. Dearness Allowance House Rent Allowance Perquisites equivalent to 35% of Annual Basic Pay Performance Related Pay Group Life Insurance Medical Reimbursement Provident Fund National Pension System Gratuity Other benefits as per company rules

content_sections.heading: BEL Probationary Legal Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The BEL Legal Officer selection process consists of a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates who satisfy the eligibility requirements will first be shortlisted for the Written Test. Candidates qualifying in the Written Test will then be provisionally shortlisted for the Interview in a ratio of 1:5. The final selection will be based on the candidate's performance in both the Written Test and Interview. The minimum qualifying marks apply separately to both the Written Test and Interview.

content_sections.heading: BEL Legal Officer Written Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Written Test will be conducted in Bengaluru only. BEL will communicate the exact date and time of the Written Test to eligible candidates through the email address provided in the application form. Candidates should therefore ensure that they provide a valid and active email address while applying.

content_sections.heading: BEL Legal Officer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee for the Probationary Legal Officer post is Rs. 600 plus 18% GST. The application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances. The application fee must be paid through SBI Collect. Candidates should select the payment category for Legal Officer (E-II) - On Permanent Basis for Bengaluru Complex. After payment, candidates must: Note the SBI Collect Reference Number. Enter the SBI Collect Reference Number in the application form. Take a printout of the payment receipt. Attach the payment receipt with the application form. Candidates should use the same mobile number and email ID for the SBI Collect payment that they have provided in the application form. Payment through cheque, demand draft or cash will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEL Probationary Legal Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application process for BEL Probationary Legal Officer Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates must download the prescribed application form, fill it correctly and send it along with the required documents through post. Download the prescribed BEL Probationary Legal Officer application form. Fill in all the required information carefully. Pay the application fee through SBI Collect, if applicable. Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents. Attach the SBI Collect payment receipt, if applicable. Place the completed application and documents in an envelope. Write the prescribed post name on the envelope. Send the application to BEL's Bengaluru address so that it reaches on or before 20 August 2026. Manager (HR/CSG), Bharat Electronics Limited, Jalahalli Post, Bengaluru - 560 013 The envelope containing the application and relevant documents should be superscribed: "Application for the post of Probationary Legal Officer on Permanent Basis - BEL Bengaluru Complex"

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BEL Legal Officer Application 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit self-attested photocopies of the required documents along with the completed application form. SSLC/SSC/10th Standard marks card as proof of date of birth LLB/BL Degree Certificate Final consolidated marks sheet Final Degree Certificate Final-year marks sheet if the final degree certificate has not yet been issued Provisional Degree Certificate, if available CGPA/credit-to-percentage conversion formula, where applicable Caste/Tribe certificate, where applicable Disability certificate for PwBD candidates, where applicable SBI Collect payment receipt, where applicable Valid identity proof Additional certificates, if any Accepted identity proof includes Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, Voter ID, Passport or PAN Card.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for BEL Legal Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. The application must reach BEL on or before 20 August 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Incomplete applications or applications submitted without required documents may be rejected. Candidates should enter all information correctly as changes will not be permitted after submission. Merely meeting the minimum eligibility conditions does not guarantee shortlisting for the Written Test or Interview. Shortlisting will be based on the information provided by candidates in the application form. False information can lead to rejection, debarment or cancellation of appointment. Future communication with candidates will be made primarily through email. Candidates working in Government, PSU or Semi-Government organizations must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of Interview.
